Hey Alex,

Talk soon!

subject: Re: Encord and Presien
text:
Hi James and Yianni,

Here's a breakdown of our current approach to MLOPs at Presien.
I've attached a diagram of our pipeline, plus a table explaining each bit
and tried to highlight the bits that are currently sticking points for us.
These are primarily:

   - Recurring error identification
      - We do Active Learnign to get general errors and "Reactive-Learning"
      based on identifying potential FPs (primarily led by our customers plus
      some automation) but finding recurring patterns in both FPs and FNs is
      tricky
      - FPs we have a manual UI we have developed for visually sorting
      alerts into common issue groups
      - FNs we heavily rely on our AL pipeline, without having a good
      ability to detect recurring ones, over that through customer feedback and
      our own deployment testing. When we do spot a FN error, we will try and
      recreate it, but we do not have a good way of scanning our data for these
      other than simple image-feature searches (we are looking into using
      metadata, eg vehicle motion as well)
   - Creation and maintenance of regression tests from the above

I remember us chatting about maybe sending you some example data from our
pipeline, is this something you will need for the demo? I'll have to check
what we can send if so.

Let me know if you have any questions, otherwise I'm looking forward to
Monday.

subject: AW: Dürr Dental & Encord | Next steps
text:
Hi Leo,

here some feedback.

  *
Encord seems currently to be very good in 3D annotations.
  *
We will start developing 3D AI based features in 1-2 years. Currently this is not really foreseeable.
  *
Encord has a lot of features. This enables you to have a widespread customer range. For us only a subset is needed.
  *
Currently there is lot of movement in the AI tools market.
  *
Dental industry is a slow industry until innovation is established in the market.
  *
ROI does need time. Current overall investments are high.
  *
Binding to a 2 year contract with yearly costs above 10-20k € is from our point of view a big invest.

Hope this helps.

Alexander
